description: Keeps the main thread in an orchestrator role. Blocks Fable subagents, warns when a subagent model cannot be resolved, and holds subagents to verified reporting.

hooks.prompt:
You are checking whether a subagent verified its claims before reporting.

First, a loop guard. If stop_hook_active is true, or the transcript shows this subagent was already blocked once on this task, return decision 'approve' immediately and check nothing else. Never block the same subagent twice.

Otherwise, block only when the report does all of the following: states a factual finding about the codebase, gives no file:line reference or command output as evidence for it, and does not label it as unverified or uncertain.

Approve in every other case. Approve when the subagent cited evidence, when it flagged what it could not check, when it asked a question, when it reported finding nothing, and when it returned a list of files or a structured set of findings in its own agreed format. Approve short factual answers that name the file they came from. When in doubt, approve.

If you block, return decision 'block' and name the specific unsupported claims. Tell the subagent to verify each one by reading the file or running the command, then report again with file:line evidence.
